entries.case: scientific-js: diffuse-off is bit-identical to all 12 captured CP6 cases
entries.messagePrefix: Expected values to be strictly equal:
entries.firstRed: red at the tested candidate (this branch; vendor bytes unchanged since import); reported red by the sibling verification census (issue 105)
entries.evidence: vendor/real-sky/tests/cp74_compositor.test.mjs:15 (hash 8d6a35c4... observed vs 8b6af133... captured); R0038 row R38-X1 (docs/state-contracts/R0038.md section 7.2, record docs/state-contracts/evidence/R0038/x1/): Windows clone at 06b6e93b, unchanged vendor bytes, Python 3.11.9: Node v22.16.0 305/305 on two runs (runner PASS); Node v24.14.0 304/305 on two runs, only this case red, actual 8d6a35c4bf8d563a5d26c9829eca7cd3027fa8affc5abc83aa1d2fcbe0416517 vs captured 8b6af133990f531c1561dfb397062d65e71eae56bb0d589a1eb993c6c0f042ee (runner FAIL); an independent reviewer reproduced one run of each with the same results; R002A recorded the same actual digest on Linux at Node v24.14.0
entries.disposition: immutable vendor oracle; no vendor edit. Cause narrowed by R0038 R38-X1 to Node-runtime-version sensitivity of an exact-bit fixture: green at the qualification-recorded Node v22.16.0, red at the gate's Node v24.14.0 on Windows and Linux with the same digest, so not host-OS dependent and not a vendor or product byte change. causeClass stays 'undetermined' because the runner's closed vocabulary (R0028 section 1) has no runtime-version class and none of the other four fits; the vocabulary is unchanged. Entry retained active by owner decision 2026-11-22: the hosted Node runtime is not changed, the vendor oracle is not re-captured and the entry is not retired to make the gate green. Not established: the runtime component responsible (V8, ICU or other), the runtime that captured the CP6 fixtures (unknown), any effect on browser-shipped bundles
entries.discriminator: RUN on both halves (R0038 R38-X1, 2026-11-22). Host half: R002A, red on Linux at Node v24.14.0 with the same digest as Windows. Node half: tools/cp9/run_scientific_regressions.py at Node v22.16.0 (official node-v22.16.0-win-x64.zip, 35466975 bytes, sha256 21c2d9735c80b8f86dab19305aa6a9f6f59bbc808f68de3eef09d5832e3bfbbd, equal to nodeZipSha256 in docs/real-sky/evidence/environment.json and to SHASUMS256.txt) passes this case and the whole suite; at v24.14.0 only this case fails. v22.16.0 is the version in the CP9 import's qualification receipt, not a vendor pin. Residual: the component is not isolated; Linux at v22.16.0 not run. Running the registered runner at Node v22.16.0 reports this active entry as an unexpected pass (FAIL); that is expected, not a defect
entries.trigger: an owner-authorised change of the Node runtime the gate uses for vendor-scientific (re-run; if green there, retire this entry in the same change), or an owner vendor-oracle decision on the CP6 fixture; until either, the entry stays active
